method: Dark Khmer-theme redesign of every page (user request: match the live browser design). Agent rendered all 31 master pages at 120 dpi and inspected them at readable size in groups of four; the 40 dpi overview of all pages was also reviewed. The integration verifier checks that every extracted page is pixel-identical to its master page.
findings: All pages use the near-black background, bronze frames and lines, bone text, Battambang headings and Kantumruy Pro body text.
Cut cards: dark lacquer, bronze cut border with inner frame, art in a temple-arch frame with a lotus finial; identities, IDs and gameplay text unchanged and readable.
Writing areas (workshop record fields, dashboard counters, offer-slip checkboxes) are parchment so pencil stays legible.
Cover adds the reaper ferryman vector from the browser and a lotus rule; the 50 mm calibration line is unchanged.
Minor: the "instance: ____" blank on the two PoLong templates is on dark card, so pencil there is low contrast.
limitations: Digital inspection only; dark full-page printing uses heavy ink, and printed color, dark-art detail, scale and handling need a person.
Rules text, card geometry and component counts were not changed.

previousReview.method: Agent opened all 31 master pages at readable 110 dpi using the image viewer. Page 7 was rebuilt with an additional 3 mm section gap and opened again. The integration verifier checks that all other final renders are unchanged and that every extracted page is pixel-identical to its master page.
findings: Readable cover, one-page guide, assembly, full rules and blank human record.
Page 7's final section was visually too close to the Passage paragraph. Added 3 mm without changing text, page count, component IDs or rules; inspected the final page again.
Five whole mats retain readable counters, four ordinary seats, separate PoLong spaces and concealed-route staging.
All cut-sheet labels, artwork identities, memory effects, anger tracks, cut borders and small marker labels are visible without clipping.
No remaining visible text collision, missing glyph, clipped effect or cut-border defect in the final render.
limitations: Not an actual printer, cutting or handling check
Not a human playtest or team art approval
